wikipedia.title: Agua Caliente Solar Project
wikipedia.extract: The Agua Caliente Solar Project is a 290 megawatt (MWAC)  photovoltaic power station, built in Yuma County, Arizona using 5.2 million cadmium telluride modules made by the U.S. thin-film manufacturer First Solar. It was the largest solar facility in the world when the project was commissioned in April 2014.
